title: Decentralized Collaborative Coding
tagline: A hands on AI based gateway to a shared adventure, empowering users to explore, learn, and create together in the fascinating landscape of Web3.
description:
Our web3 journey began in the vibrant realm of the ETH India Hackathon 2022, As newcomers to the world of Web3, we nd out that understanding the complex concepts of the blockchain and crypt world was quite a struggle, but we managed to bag a pool prize for push protocol. Now, The need for collaborative discussion and peer learning became evident,which lead us to build a platform where we could collectively work on building dapps on web3.
